about_the_game:
Description

You wake up in an office inside an abandoned asylum. You don’t know how you got there… but you do know who wants you there: a deranged mind obsessed with forcing victims into “games” designed to break them.

This time, his inspiration is a twisted homage to his favorite series. Five nights. Cameras that don’t always show the truth. Enemies that seem motionless… until they’re not. And a Host who sees everything.

Each night is a trial. Every rule, a trap. And every second you survive is an invitation for the game to become even more personal.

Will you win… or will you simply last longer than the others?

Key Features:

  • Survive 5 nights of extreme psychological tension.

  • Monitor tampered cameras that hide crucial movements.

  • Face human enemies with unpredictable behaviors.

  • Uncover the macabre backstory of the Host and his “games.”

  • Oppressive atmosphere in an abandoned asylum filled with unsettling details.

  • 2 special nights lasting 6 real-time hours each.

    Information and Recommendations

    In Twisted Games, every decision matters and every second you hesitate could be your last. This is not a shooter or an action-packed game: here, psychological tension is your worst enemy… and your only defense is vigilance and resource management.

    Recommendations:

    • Play with headphones. Directional audio will warn you about things you won’t see on screen.

    • Stay calm. Jump scares are inevitable, but panicking will lead to mistakes.

    • Observe patterns. Some enemies move in predictable ways, others act completely at random. Learn to tell them apart.

    • Do not neglect Camera 8. You don’t need to know why… just do it.

    • Manage your power wisely. Closing doors and checking cameras consumes resources. Overuse will leave you defenseless.

    • Pay attention to visual details. The Host leaves clues in the cameras and the environment… even if you’d rather not see them.

    • Play in the dark. For the full experience, turn off the lights and let the asylum surround you.

    Warning:
    This game contains disturbing images and sounds, and is not recommended for players sensitive to intense horror environments, jump scares, or prolonged psychological tension.

content_descriptors.notes: This game does not contain sexually explicit scenes. However, it includes certain parts with partial body exposure or elements that, depending on the player’s interpretation, could be perceived as suggestive. These elements are included solely for narrative and aesthetic purposes, with no explicit sexual intent.

name: Twisted Games

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10210U or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 or higher (GTX 1660, RTX 3050, etc.)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: "Twisted Games" locks you in an abandoned asylum turned into a mentally ill attraction. Survive five nights watching altered cameras, while unpredictable enemies lurk in the darkness. This might sound familiar... the host knows.
supported_languages:
Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support
